tagline.en: A vision-language-action policy trained with reinforcement learning for robot control.
tagline.zh: 以强化学习训练的视觉-语言-动作策略,用于机器人控制。

en: LaST-R1 is a vision-language-action (VLA) model for robot control, developed with a reinforcement-learning stage in its training. It maps visual observations and instructions to robot actions as a policy.
WorldFoundry runs LaST-R1 through an official-policy runtime adapter, so it fits the shared inference flow. The published checkpoint is hosted on Hugging Face and pulled in at run time.
In WorldFoundry you give the model observations and it returns an action policy rollout.
zh: LaST-R1 是一个用于机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型,其训练中包含强化学习阶段。它以策略的形式,把视觉观测与指令映射为机器人动作。
WorldFoundry 通过官方策略运行时适配器运行 LaST-R1,使其契合统一的推理流程。已发布的 checkpoint 托管于 Hugging Face,在运行时载入。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你把观测交给模型,它便返回动作策略推演。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a reinforcement-learning-trained VLA policy for robot control and action rollouts.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个以强化学习训练、用于机器人控制与动作推演的 VLA 策略时,选它。

notFor.en: It is a control policy, not a media generator — it outputs robot actions. The checkpoint downloads separately, so stage it before running.
notFor.zh: 它是控制策略而非媒体生成器——输出的是机器人动作。Checkpoint 需单独下载,请在运行前先备好。

en: Runs through an official-policy runtime adapter
zh: 面向机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作策略
训练中包含强化学习阶段
通过官方策略运行时适配器运行
Checkpoint 已发布于 Hugging Face
